Synopsis:
    Satellogic hired retired U.S. Navy Vice Admiral Frank Whitworth, former head of the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, as President. He will oversee operations and defense/intelligence strategy. The company is building its "Merlin" constellation (8 satellites initially) to deliver daily global Earth imaging, targeting military, intelligence, and logistics clients. First Merlin launch is slated for October. The hire signals an aggressive push into the U.S. defense and intelligence market.
